clusters.mechanism: INERT_MEDIA_PATH and the validator omit many requested inert-media extensions (PDF, MP4, BMP, AVIF, 3D formats and others), so those files wrongly require Allow: binary.
The PNG parser's fixed chunk allowlist rejects ordinary ancillary metadata chunks such as tEXt, so valid PNGs with normal metadata lose the exemption.
clean() rejects short magic signatures such as MZ anywhere in media bytes, so valid PCM or compressed data that contains them by coincidence is blocked.
The 32 MiB size or decompression cap (MEDIA_LIMIT) removes the exemption from valid large media, which then lands in binaryPaths and is blocked.
The new 1,941-line media parser module far exceeds the requested 40-source-line budget for what should be an extension-list change.
